task: Where can I find General Motors' latest 10-K filing?

merged.claim: As of November 11, 2026, General Motors' latest 10-K is its annual report for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025.

variants.F: General Motors' latest 10-K is its fiscal-year 2025 annual report; General Motors' FY2025 10-K covers the period ending 2025-12-31.

variants.C: As of November 11, 2026, General Motors Company's latest Form 10-K covers the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025.
variants.E: General Motors' latest 10-K (as of 2026-11-11) is its annual report for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025.

merged.claim: General Motors filed its latest 10-K (FY2025) with the SEC on January 27, 2026.
